mission_1.search: So both BFS and A* are  13.5m, but A* expanded 228 fewer nodes than BFS because of its guide that is used for the search of the goal, while BFS explores each cell in order of discovery.
mission_1.failure: On the constrained map, BFS found the shortest path at 24.5 m; however, DFS found the longer path of 50m because BFS explores cells level by level, whereas DFS follows one path for a while before it has to backtrack. IDDFS hits the resource limit because it repeatedly searches with increasing depth limits. For the unreachable map, BFS, DFS, and A* returned no_path; however, IDDFS returned resource limit.  No path means the search finished and found no route; resource limit means the algorithm ran out of allowed expansions before finishing. I used AI to help me fully understand what each algorithm is and how they work, as well as to help me implement each of the algorithms. I always verify and ensure I understand how everything is implemented. This allowed me to understand what each search algorithm resulted in on each map and understand the reasoning behind it.
